WON SAO NYI (郭紹儀) - Age 41, a native of Hopei. From 1919 to 1922 served as a constable and later sergeant in the Nanking Constabulary. Came to Shanghai in 1923 and joined the Woosung-Shanghai Constabulary as a sergeant. Appointed Inspector in 1925 in charge of the 3rd Sub-Station in Nantao of the 1st Division of the Constabulary. Resigned this position in 1936. During March 1938, appointed Chief of the River Police of the Dah Dao City Government on the recommendation of a Japanese connected with the Japanese Cotton Mill Owners' Federation.

CONCERNING THE FORMATION OF AN ASSASSINATION GANG.

Made by ... and Forwarded by... D. I. Glover

Sir,

On the 5th and 20th June 1939, two anonymous letters were received by the Secretariat, S.M.C., alleging that certain persons who had established a clandestine hire car service known as the "Fah Chi" (法記) Garage, located at No. 23, Lane 930, Avenue Foch, were with the aid of officials of the Reformed Government forming an assassination Corps for the elimination of certain anti-Japanese official .

From enquiries made by Detectives attached to this branch it has been ascertained that such a garage does exist, but there would appear no truth in the allegation that the persons connected with it are members of an assassination Corps.

This business was organised by two men named Sung Hei Tao (宋海濤) and Wong Zei Ming (黃才明), who, by operating cars under private license plates, have succeeded, through the introduction of one named Zung (陳), Chief of the "Navigation Bureau of the Shanghai City Government", in obtaining monthly contracts from individuals in the employ of the Reformed Government.

The undermentioned three cars, licensed as private vehicles, and ostensibly owned by the following persons, are known to belong to this Coy. :-

(1) 1510 - Jordan D. Sze (史久棠), House No. 27, Lane No. 516, Gordon Road.
(2) 5776 - Zing Zoong Sing (秦宗星), House 89, Lane 930, Avenue Road.
(3) 10037 - Hsu Pau (許沛棠), House 32, Lane 18, Jessfield Road.

The first mentioned registered owner, Jordan D. Sze, is a well known disreputable character, who was formerly

先生，

1939年6月5日和20日，工部局秘书处收到两封匿名信，指控某些人在福煦路930弄23号建立了一个名为“法记”（Fah Chi）的秘密出租车行，并在维新政府官员的协助下，组建了一支暗杀队，以清除某些反日官员。

经本部所属侦探调查，确认该车行确实存在，但所谓与其有关的人员是暗杀队成员的说法似乎并无事实依据。

该业务由宋海涛（Sung Hei Tao，宋海濤）和黄才明（Wong Zei Ming，黃才明）两人组织，他们通过悬挂私人牌照运营车辆，并经由一名陈姓（Zung，陳）人士（时任“上海市政府航政局”局长）的介绍，成功获得了受雇于维新政府的个人的月度包车合同。

以下三辆注册为私人车辆、名义上归下列人员所有的汽车，已知属于该公司：-

(1) 1510 - 史久棠（Jordan D. Sze），戈登路516弄27号。
(2) 5776 - 秦宗星（Zing Zoong Sing，秦宗星），爱文义路930弄89号。
(3) 10037 - 许沛棠（Hsu Pau，許沛棠），极司菲尔路18弄32号。

与前巡佐马尚书（Mo Zang S，馬尚書）（上海公共租界工部局警务处）有牵连，后者因盗窃大量桐油案被捕并定罪（C.l. Misc. 167/37）。

    (5)  姚大块头（Yao Dah Kwei Deu，姚大塊頭），别名本元（Pung Hypen，本元），别名重光（Zoong Kwaung，重光），是一名“无业游民”，已知是樊良伯（Van Liang Pah，樊良伯）的党羽。
    (6)  张殿甲（Tsang Dien Chah，張殿甲），山东人，是一名无业游民，曾任大世界游乐场的职业拳击手。目前不在上海。
